The design is fixed and all tests pass (`TEST PASSED`).

Root cause: `refill` was computed as `timer == rate - 1` with no guard for `rate == 0`, so when refill was disabled, `rate - 1` underflowed to all-ones and incorrectly triggered refills (and the timer never reset to 0 as required). It also used `==` instead of `>=`, which would break the "reduce rate mid-period" catch-up behavior. Fixed by gating `refill` on `rate != 0` and using `>=`, and forcing `timer` to 0 whenever `rate == 0`.
